Let's discuss indie games that are great and what elevates them to that level.

My example of this is I consider Shovel Knight a good game and Risk of Rain a great game even though from a technical standpoint I would consider Shovel Knight the better game.

While Shovel Knight does everything decently nothing about it really stuck with me. It was just good in every way but not great in anything. Risk of Rain on the other hand is what I would consider a great game. It isn't perfect but it has elements to it that create an immersive and memorable experience. The music and level design are what really set this game apart. It blows me away how beautifully the two mix. Also, while I would say shovel knight has better gameplay mechanics I still enjoyed Risk of Rain's more due to the variety the different characters bring and how unique they all look and play. To me all of these things far outweigh the overall lack of different levels, shortness of gameplay, and stale enemy variety and makes Risk of Rain one of my favorite indie games of all time.
